biography.background:
Riven est une Humaine Engineer "Modder". La technologie et la robotique sont ses passe-temps. Elle est capable d'inventer une solution technologique en quelques secondes, lui permettant d'accéder à des compétences qu'elle n'a pas habituellement !

Comment jouer Riven ?

  • Vous êtes humain, le Stress ça vous connaît, vous pouvez l'absorber mieux que d'autres.

  • Utilisez votre @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.139uKV0SfomfSmUJ]{Ingenuity} pour éviter le pire !

  • Le savoir fait tout, @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.6mUfKFyCbxLGh5BE]{Live and learn} vous permet de faire relancer un jet raté à un allié.

  • Eurêka ! Allez chercher des cartes auxquelles vous n'avez normalement pas accès avec @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.h8j0zd1pi39JFy12]{Just an Idea} !

  • Déployez des drones pour explorer les environs avec @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.cWCfF37m7YPuRW2W]{Field Devices} !

  • Utilisez votre Scanner Tactique pour détecter les formes de vie autour de vous, avant de tomber dans une embuscade !

system.description: When you or an ally fails a roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll with advantage.

Once per session, you may spend a Hope and explain with some technical and incomprehensible words why something that just happened isn't quite possible. Then do one of the following:

  • Avoid marking a Hit Point, Stress or Armor Slot.

  • Add or substract 2 from any roll (include adversaries).

After the first time you use this feature during a session and once per scene, you can use Ingenuity by giving the GM a Fear instead of spending a Hope.

system.description: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can mark a Stress to reroll.
You have Advantage on the Work on a Project downtime move if it requires you to make a roll to advance a countdown. You can also take the Work on a Project downtime move during a short rest.

At the beggining of each session, place a number of Modder tokens on this card equal to your Finesse or Knowledge trait.

You can spend Modder tokens equal to the Recall Cost of any domain card you are eligible for that is not in your current loadout. If the Recall Cost is 0, it still costs one Modder token. Take that domain card into your loadout, it becomes a Mod card. If your loadout is full, place one of your cards in your Vault.

If you would ever place a Mod card in your vault, discard it instead.

Once per long rest, when you use @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.h8j0zd1pi39JFy12]{Just an Idea} to take a domain card, you can choose a card from any domain up to one Tier below your current Tier.

You may only have one domain card from a domain you do not normally have access to in your loadout at any time.
When you use @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.zDOA9DFaq6U67JkK]{Breakthrough}, you can choose a card from any domain up to your level.
When you use @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.h8j0zd1pi39JFy12]{Just an Idea}, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
Humans are most easily recognized by their dexterous hands, rounded ears, and bodies built for endurance.

Being part of a forgeborne community means you were raised in massive industrial complexes, orbital foundries, or bustling shipyards where construction and repair never truly stop. Your people solve problems with ingenuity, tools, and perseverance rather than brute force.

Forgeborne are often diligent, inventive, patient, resourceful, steadfast, and meticulous.

  • Add 1d6 damage to the next successful attack made by the target with a primary weapon.

  • Grant +2 Evasion to the target until they are hit by an attack.

system.description: You don't need any lighter for as long as you have batteries.

Three times per rest, you can activate the tactical scan to detect signs of life and movement within a Far range around you. You know the general direction, general distance and approximate size of the life forms.

Recon Drone: Mark a Stress to deploy a small floating bot that you can move anywhere within Very Far Range. While this ability is active, you can see through the bot as though you’re in its position. You can transition between using your own senses and seeing through the bot freely. If the bot takes damage or moves out of range, the ability ends.

Medical Drone: Make a Spellcast Roll (13) and target a creature other than yourself within Melee range. On a success, mark a Stress to clear 1 Hit Point or 1 Stress on the target. You can't heal the same target again until your next long rest.

Movement Detector: You can place a number of movement detectors up to your spellcasting trait. Each detector is able to sense movement in a Very Close range and send you a notification when it does.
